Exact fixture

phase1__hero-rare-2-1 and phase1__hero-rare-2-3. Ability HTML is "Draw a card. " repeated 12 times, including the final space. Flavor HTML is <i>A little more to say.</i>. There are no explicit ability breaks or inline icons.

Identical inputs

Rare single-color Instinct Hero; cost 4, no cost asterisk; Recruit/Attack enabled, both values 0 with plus signs; no artwork. Titles: Card Title / Hero Name. Requested rules size 22, flavor size 11. These before/after images were reproduced from the preserved Phase 2.6 sources and current production. All four 1x/3x images match the saved regression PNGs pixel-for-pixel. This sheet uses the matching 3x images on both sides.

Why an extra line appears

The old first line holds three complete sentences, using 334.803 units. That fits the old 344-unit upper width but exceeds the selected 330-unit width by 4.803. The second old line similarly needs 340.641 units, including its leading space. The new word breaks then encounter the badge contour and eventually leave the final "card." on a sixth line.

Why overflow increases by 11

Both versions reach the existing normal fitting floor of 21. This is multi-sentence prose, so Phase 2.5 protection supplies no extra shrinking allowance. Five old lines at 29 units occupy 145 units; six new lines at 26 occupy 156. With origin 526 and region bottom 668, that yields 3 versus 14 units of reported vertical overflow.

Is this a poor wrapping choice?

A read-only audit enumerated legal word-boundary partitions for all 36 measured tokens at font 21 and the current 26-unit origins, using the raw three-unit-clearance contour instead of retained conservative limits. No five-line partition fits: at most 35 tokens fit. Six lines are required under these fixed constraints. This does not identify an avoidable extra line caused by the iterative solver. A different six-line arrangement could look more balanced, but would not recover the measured height.

Important qualification

This is a consequence of the combined selected width, contour, spacing and font floor, not proof that the real badge contour alone makes the regression inevitable. The initial wrapping divergence happens above the badge because of the 330-unit width. The retained right edge at Y604 is 372.717 versus a raw contour edge of 373; releasing that small conservative difference still does not permit five lines.

What the overflow numbers mean

Reported rules overflow includes the logical line box. Actual last-line ink ends at Y657.75 before (inside the intended region), versus Y671.75 after (3.75 units beyond it). Thus 14 is not fourteen units of visible ink below the boundary. Flavor starts below the existing Y668 flavor clip in both versions and is not visible in either card. Its original positioning/clipping algorithm was not changed.

Scope

No production code, fitting policy, contour logic, font limits, spacing, assets or saved state were changed for this review. Production hashes were verified unchanged. All work remains uncommitted.
